name: REID, Gordon James

headline.note: Primary and reliable secondary sources establish a public-hospital medical career through internship, junior and senior residency and emergency medicine at Gosford, Woy Woy and Wyong hospitals, followed by volunteer clinical service while in Parliament. They do not provide exact appointment dates, paid hours, leave or boundaries between hospitals and grades. Elected office, campaigning, study and volunteer medicine are excluded; no public full-time total is inferred from professional titles or approximate year narratives.

career_spells.role: Bachelor of Medicine student and Central Coast clinical student
career_spells.evidence_note: Reid and the University identify his Newcastle medical degree and clinical training at Gosford; secondary biographical reporting dates completion to 2016. Enrolment start, study load, placements and paid-work overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study and clinical placements are excluded unless separate paid employment is documented.

career_spells.employer: Central Coast Local Health District, NSW Health
career_spells.role: Intern; junior and senior resident medical officer; emergency career medical officer
career_spells.evidence_note: AMA NSW records internship, junior and senior residencies and emergency rotations at Gosford, Woy Woy and Wyong hospitals. Parliament's Senate inquiry identifies Reid as Emergency Career Medical Officer at Wyong, while his 2024 first-person account confirms the progression from medical student through senior resident and later emergency work. Exact appointments, hospital transfers, paid hours, leave and cessation of paid employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The public employer and substantive medical work are supported, but full-time status and countable dates are not sufficiently documented.

career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporaneous reporting announced the candidacy in September 2021; ABC profiled Reid as the Labor candidate and Parliament records election on 21 May 2022. Exact preselection day, campaign remuneration, workload and overlap with hospital employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Robertson
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current Parliament profile establish continuous House service from the 21 May 2022 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Central Coast public hospitals / Wyong Hospital
career_spells.evidence_note: Reid's current biography says he continues medical service at local hospitals in a volunteer capacity, and a 2024 release expressly calls his Wyong practice pro bono. Government transcripts in 2023 and 2024 confirm continuing practice after election. The election date is used only as the boundary between clearly pre-parliament employment and post-election service; exact volunteering dates and hours are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Documented volunteer/pro-bono medicine is visible but excluded from paid public/private full-time totals.

research_notes: Obtain the University of Newcastle graduation record and Central Coast Local Health District employment statement or payroll history with exact appointment, transfer and cessation dates across Gosford, Woy Woy and Wyong.
Determine substantive full-time status, hours, leave and breaks for internship, junior/senior residency and emergency career medical officer service; do not infer hours from medical titles.
Resolve paid-employment cessation and the transition to post-election volunteer/pro-bono clinical service, including whether any paid shifts continued after 21 May 2022.
Determine campaign remuneration and workload from September 2021 to election and its overlap with hospital work. No private-sector employment is documented, but missing evidence is not zero.
